# Submission: Aktogay Sulphide Shift Twin

Platform: OpenEgiz v1.0.4.

## Concept

**Enterprise:** The twin represents one sulphide ore value chain at the real
Aktogay open-pit copper operation in Kazakhstan: one representative pit phase,
haulage, a primary crusher, a ROM stockpile and one concentrator line.

**Users:** The primary user is the shift dispatcher, who assigns trucks to
faces and destinations. The shift mining engineer sets blend targets. The
plant shift supervisor needs an estimate of near-term feed rate, grade and
hardness.

**Decision:** After a crusher, truck, haul road or power disruption, how should
the dispatcher reassign trucks and adjust the ore blend to keep concentrator
feed as steady as the available fleet, stockpile and power allow?

**Why this choice:** The crusher and concentrator constrain the linked
production chain. A disruption changes truck cycles and queues, ROM inventory,
feed rate, feed quality, recovery and power demand. Dispatchers need to compare
these effects within a shift. The twin puts those connected states in a
spatial view and exposes repeatable what-if scenarios.

**Real or fictional:** Aktogay is the real site. KAZ Minerals reports the
original sulphide concentrator at 25 Mt/year in *Annual Report and Accounts
2017*, p. 30, and the later second 25 Mt/year concentrator, bringing the
sulphide design capacity to 50 Mt/year. This
submission models one representative 25 Mt/year line, not the whole mine or
plant. The simulation's capacity basis is 3,200 t/h × 24 h/day × 365 day/year
× 90% operating factor = 25.23 Mt/year, rounded to 25 Mt/year. The 90% factor
and 3,200 t/h operating value are modeling assumptions, not a published
Aktogay operating record. Public sources are listed in
`docs/DATA_AND_ASSUMPTIONS.md`.

## Team

**Tau-Ken Labs (Team-064)**. Sole member and developer: **Majhabul Hoque Tahsim**.

| GitHub |
|---|
| **@Catacombs666** |

## Mine

Version 3.0 represents 29 Eclipse Ditto things in namespace `org.aktogay`: the
mine, three areas, one pit phase, three ore faces, one waste cut, two haul roads,
two shared shovels, eight truck twins (2–8 active), a crusher, ROM stockpile,
concentrator, substation, maintenance crew, dispatch service, waste dump and tailings accounting twin. `_parents`
represents containment; `feeds`, `supplies`, `connects` and `loaded_by` record
process relationships. Three-dimensional scene positions are illustrative.

The mine is a seeded, bounded-step material-flow model. Shovel loading resources
and the ROM dump bay serialize service; vehicles carry sampled copper/hardness
through their full cycles. ROM capacity, crusher capacity, hardness and available
power constrain downstream flow. Ore, waste and contained-copper balances are
checked. The line design basis is not a guarantee of achieved shift production.

## Modules and What-if Scenarios

| Module | Working behavior | Where to inspect |
|---|---|---|
| Haulage and dispatch | Loading queues, loaded/empty travel, dump queue, fleet availability; adaptive face selection considers grade, hardness and shovel queue. Fixed rotation is a selectable comparison policy. | 3D trucks, asset inspector, dispatcher log, Settings |
| ROM, crushing and plant | Finite ROM, mass-weighted mixing, actual processed tonnes, hardness derate, power cap and synthetic recovery. | KPI strip, ROM pile, feed chart, crusher/plant/substation inspection |
| Paired decision experiment | Two 60-minute forecasts from the identical current material and random state: baseline versus chosen fault. Result passes through the platform. | Look one hour ahead; exportable confirmed report |

Start the run using **Start Simulation**. In **What-if laboratory**, choose a
card and press **Run selected scenario**. Changing the card alone changes no
operating state. All scenarios can be undone using **Restore normal conditions**;
**Reset** clears the shift counters and returns READY using the current settings.

| Scenario | Model consequence | What is visible |
|---|---|---|
| Crusher outage | Crusher throughput stops; arrivals fill ROM until trucks queue. ROM cannot feed past the stopped crusher. | Fault indication, zero feed, changing inventory, queue and event |
| Truck breakdown | HT-03 (or the first active truck in a two-truck fleet) stops in place; its payload remains accounted for. | Stationary failed asset, reduced active fleet, retained payload |
| Main road closure | Committed trucks clear the route; subsequent trips use the longer north route with distance and gradient dependent travel. | Closure barrier, changed truck routes, longer cycles |
| Power curtailment | Supply is capped at 45 MW or the configured lower supply. | Substation state; feed ≤ 45,000/21 = 2,143 t/h |
| Low-grade F2 | New loads sample 0.18% Cu. Existing loads retain their quality. | Face condition, dispatch choices and delayed mixed feed change |
| Shovel outage | SH-02 stops. Partial payload is held. Future assignments use available shovels. | Fault state, queues, new assignments and delayed feed effects |
| Road congestion | Main road admission falls to 12 vehicles/hour/direction. | Entry queues, road overlay and wait counters |
| Hard F3 | New F3 loads sample 20 kWh/t. Adaptive dispatch can avoid F3. | Face condition, changed assignments; delayed or small plant response |

## Version 3 engineering additions

Finite ore reserves decrease during loading and depleted faces stop supplying
material. Roads admit trucks at a bounded headway per direction. Distance,
gradient and loaded/empty state determine travel time. Bucket size determines
loading passes. Waste and processing tailings have explicit accounting twins.
The resource overlay shows reserves, queues and faults. Scenario propagation
panels distinguish observed changes from matched forecasts.

The dispatch comparison runs fixed rotation and adaptive dispatch from the same
paused state and matched per-truck loading variation. It reports production,
grade error, waiting, energy and final ROM. The live shift remains unchanged.
An infeasible blend target generates a warning. See `docs/V3_UPGRADE.md`.

## Mine visualization

**http://localhost:8091** provides a locally bundled Three.js scene: graded pit
benches and ramp, moving articulated haul trucks, shared excavators, crusher,
ROM, conveyors, concentrator and substation. Orbit/pan/zoom, Fit/Top view and asset
inspection support exploration. Trucks follow confirmed route progress; loading,
dumping, breakdown, road closure and plant status are reflected visually.

The UI does not combine initial twin values with newer local events. The entire
operator snapshot is published through MQTT and read back from one Ditto feature,
with a run ID, sequence and timestamp. Stale state holds the scene and is labelled.
The separate local development mode is explicitly labelled and is not the Stand.

## Data and Assumptions

The published Aktogay identity, process route and line capacity remain the only
real-site grounding. Every operating grade, cycle, fleet setting, inventory,
recovery response and coordinate is synthetic. See `docs/DATA_AND_ASSUMPTIONS.md`
for sources, equations and ranges; `ASSET_CREDITS.md` for third-party graphics rights.
Settings apply to a new paused/ready shift, so changes do not erase in-flight
material during normal operation. The model is not calibrated to operator records.

## What works and what does not

Version 3 model/API validation passes 31 tests. A five-seed, five-condition
benchmark records all 25 matched policy comparisons, including adverse tradeoffs.
The v3 browser interface is implemented but has not been visually verified here.
User-supplied screenshots in the presentation show the preceding working version.
They are labelled accordingly and do not prove v3 integration.

**Not yet verified:** Docker/Stand startup, real broker delivery and Ditto
acceptance, Telegraf/InfluxDB ingestion and Grafana display. Docker is absent in
the authoring environment. Run `bash scripts/verify-aktogay.sh` after the integrated
startup; it checks these paths and writes an honest pass/fail report. A broker
publish alone is never treated as confirmation of a twin update.

## Limitations

The model has shared shovel resources, but no shovel relocation time, detailed
truck collision/overtaking dynamics, surveyed terrain, calibrated comminution circuit, fuel consumption, automatic repair duration,
tailings storage engineering or operational safety logic. Road lengths and 3D scene units
are different scales; equipment is enlarged for readability. Graphics quality
is selectable and software rendering has a reduced-resolution profile. All
state is in memory and a service restart begins a new shift; reports can be exported.

## Presentation

`presentation.pdf` describes the concept, 3D controls, platform data path,
scenario behavior, paired experiment, data assumptions and verification boundary.

"""Seeded pit-to-plant model. Seconds internally; tonnes, % Cu and MW externally.
Synthetic engineering assumptions, not Aktogay operating records.
"""
import copy
import math
import random
import hashlib

DEFAULTS = dict(speed=60, fleet=8, crusher_tph=3200, power_mw=75, load_minutes=6.5,
                haul_minutes=9, target_grade=0.34, f1_grade=0.31, f2_grade=0.39,
                f3_grade=0.27, hardness=12.4, seed=64, dispatch='adaptive', face_tonnes=85000, road_capacity=36,
                main_grade=6, north_grade=8, bucket_t=45)
BOUNDS = dict(speed=(1,180), fleet=(2,8), crusher_tph=(500,4500), power_mw=(10,90),
              load_minutes=(3,12), haul_minutes=(5,20), target_grade=(0.15,0.8),
              f1_grade=(0.1,1), f2_grade=(0.1,1), f3_grade=(0.1,1), hardness=(8,24), seed=(0,999999),
              face_tonnes=(220,150000), road_capacity=(6,60), main_grade=(0,12),
              north_grade=(0,12), bucket_t=(25,65))
SCENARIOS = [
 dict(id='crusher-outage',name='Crusher outage',short='CR-01 offline',description='Crushing stops. Trucks feed ROM until its finite capacity forces a queue.'),
 dict(id='truck-breakdown',name='Truck breakdown',short='HT-03 unavailable',description='A loaded or empty truck stops in place. Its payload is conserved; the remaining fleet continues.'),
 dict(id='road-closure',name='Main road closure',short='Longer north route',description='Committed trucks clear the main route; subsequent trips use the longer north haul road. Distance and gradient set travel time.'),
 dict(id='power-limit',name='Power curtailment',short='45 MW supply cap',description='Plant energy limits feed to at most 2,143 t/h, or less if the configured supply is lower.'),
 dict(id='low-grade',name='Low-grade pocket',short='F2 · 0.18% Cu',description='New F2 loads have lower grade. Ore already loaded retains its sampled quality.'),
 dict(id='hard-ore',name='Hard ore at F3',short='F3 · 20 kWh/t',description='New F3 loads are harder. Adaptive dispatch can avoid this face; feed response follows transport and blending delays.'),
 dict(id='shovel-outage',name='Shovel SH-02 outage',short='F2 loading interrupted',description='SH-02 stops. A partial load is held; dispatch redirects new trucks to other available faces.'),
 dict(id='road-congestion',name='Road entry restriction',short='Main road: 12 vehicles/h/lane',description='Entry headway increases on both main-road lanes. Trucks queue before admission; trips already on the road continue.')]
ROM_CAPACITY=24000.0
ROM_INITIAL=8000.0
PAYLOAD=220.0
ENERGY=21.0
FACES=['face-west','face-east','face-north']


def validate(values):
    if not isinstance(values,dict):raise ValueError('Settings must be an object')
    unknown=set(values)-set(DEFAULTS)
    if unknown:raise ValueError('Unknown settings: '+', '.join(sorted(unknown)))
    result=dict(DEFAULTS,**values)
    for k,(lo,hi) in BOUNDS.items():
        v=result[k]
        if isinstance(v,bool) or not isinstance(v,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(v) or not lo<=v<=hi:
            raise ValueError(f'{k} must be between {lo} and {hi}')
        if k in ('fleet','seed') and int(v)!=v:raise ValueError(f'{k} must be an integer')
    if result['dispatch'] not in ('adaptive','rotation'):raise ValueError('Unknown dispatch policy')
    return result


class Mine:
    def __init__(self,settings=None):
        self.settings=validate(settings or {})
        self.rng=random.Random(self.settings['seed'])
        self.minute=0.0;self.active_scenario='baseline';self.events=[];self.event_seq=0
        self.ore_mined=0.0;self.waste_mined=0.0;self.waste_dumped=0.0
        self.processed=0.0;self.mined_cu=0.0;self.processed_cu=0.0;self.concentrate_total=0.0
        self.rom_t=ROM_INITIAL;self.rom_cu=ROM_INITIAL*0.0034
        self.rom_hardness=ROM_INITIAL*self.settings['hardness']
        self.last_feed=0.0;self.last_grade=0.34;self.last_hardness=self.settings['hardness']
        self.dispatch_count=0;self.last_decision='Ready for a new shift'
        self.reserve_initial={**{f:float(self.settings['face_tonnes']) for f in FACES},'face-waste':120000.0}
        self.remaining=dict(self.reserve_initial)
        self.road_next={r:{d:0.0 for d in ('loaded','empty')} for r in ('road-main','road-north')}
        self.road_entries={r:{d:0 for d in ('loaded','empty')} for r in self.road_next}
        self.shovel_seconds=[0.0,0.0];self.wait_seconds=0.0;self.energy_kwh=0.0
        self.grade_error_mass=0.0;self.starved_minutes=0.0;self.tailings_total=0.0;self.recovered_cu=0.0
        self.last_dispatch=None;self.scenario_started=0.0;self.scenario_reference=None
        self._conditions()
        self.trucks=[]
        for i in range(8):
            face=FACES[i%3]
            self.trucks.append(dict(id=f'truck-{i+1:02}',label=f'HT-{i+1:02}',
                state='empty_return' if i<self.settings['fleet'] else 'parked',
                timer=(i%4)*70.0,duration=self.settings['haul_minutes']*60*0.85,
                payload=0.0,cu=0.0,hardness_mass=0.0,grade=0.0,hardness=0.0,
                face=face,material='ore',route='road-main',position=1-(i%4)*70/(self.settings['haul_minutes']*60*0.85),
                speed=0.0,trips=0,reason='Initial empty return',saved_state=None,
                load_count=0,load_target=PAYLOAD,wait_seconds=0.0,wait_since=0.0,decision=None))
        for t in self.trucks:
            t['duration']=self.travel_seconds('road-main',False)
            t['timer']=min(t['timer'],t['duration']*.9)
            t['position']=1-t['timer']/t['duration']
        self.event('Shift ready. Initial ROM: 8,000 t at 0.34% Cu. Start Simulation to dispatch the fleet.')

    def _conditions(self):
        self.crusher_online=True;self.road_main_closed=False;self.broken_truck=None
        self.available_mw=self.settings['power_mw'];self.shovel_online=[True,True]
        self.face_props={f:dict(grade=self.settings[f'f{i+1}_grade'],hardness=self.settings['hardness']+d)
                         for i,(f,d) in enumerate(zip(FACES,[0.6,-0.9,2.6]))}

    def event(self,text):
        self.event_seq+=1
        self.events.insert(0,dict(id=self.event_seq,minute=round(self.minute,2),text=text))
        self.events=self.events[:40];self.last_decision=text

    def apply_scenario(self,key):
        if key not in [s['id'] for s in SCENARIOS]+['baseline']:raise ValueError('Unknown scenario')
        if self.broken_truck:
            t=next(t for t in self.trucks if t['id']==self.broken_truck)
            t['state']=t.pop('saved_state',None) or 'empty_return'
        self.scenario_reference={'minute':self.minute,'processed':self.processed,'rom_t':self.rom_t,
                                 'grade':self.rom_cu/self.rom_t*100 if self.rom_t else self.last_grade}
        self.scenario_started=self.minute
        self._conditions();self.active_scenario=key
        if key=='crusher-outage':self.crusher_online=False;self.last_feed=0
        if key=='power-limit':self.available_mw=min(45,self.settings['power_mw'])
        if key=='road-closure':self.road_main_closed=True
        if key=='truck-breakdown':
            t=next((t for t in self.trucks if t['id']=='truck-03' and t['state']!='parked'),self.trucks[0])
            self.broken_truck=t['id'];t['saved_state']=t['state'];t['state']='maintenance';t['speed']=0
        if key=='low-grade':self.face_props['face-east']['grade']=0.18
        if key=='hard-ore':self.face_props['face-north']['hardness']=20.0
        if key=='shovel-outage':self.shovel_online[1]=False
        name=next((s['name'] for s in SCENARIOS if s['id']==key),'Normal operation')
        self.event(name+' applied. Existing material retains its sampled grade and hardness.')

    def shovel(self,face):return 1 if face=='face-east' else 0

    def available_faces(self):
        return [f for f in FACES if self.remaining[f]>1e-8 and self.shovel_online[self.shovel(f)]]

    def assign(self,t):
        faces=self.available_faces()
        waste=(self.dispatch_count+1)%11==0 and self.remaining['face-waste']>1e-8 and self.shovel_online[0]
        if not faces and not waste:
            t.update(state='waiting_for_resource',speed=0,position=0,reason='No available ore face/shovel')
            return
        self.dispatch_count+=1
        candidates=[]
        if waste:face='face-waste'
        elif self.settings['dispatch']=='rotation':face=faces[(self.dispatch_count-1)%len(faces)]
        else:
            # All material already committed to ROM, including loaded trucks.
            mass=self.rom_t+sum(x['payload'] for x in self.trucks if x['material']=='ore')
            copper=self.rom_cu+sum(x['cu'] for x in self.trucks if x['material']=='ore')
            for f in faces:
                prop=self.face_props[f];payload=min(PAYLOAD,self.remaining[f])
                projected=(copper+payload*prop['grade']/100)/max(1,mass+payload)*100
                q=sum(x is not t and x['state'] in ('loading','queue_at_shovel') and self.shovel(x['face'])==self.shovel(f) for x in self.trucks)
                grade_penalty=abs(projected-self.settings['target_grade'])*40
                queue_penalty=q*.10
                hard_penalty=max(0,prop['hardness']-self.settings['hardness'])*.025
                candidates.append(dict(face=f,projected_grade=projected,queue_trucks=q,
                    grade_penalty=grade_penalty,queue_penalty=queue_penalty,hardness_penalty=hard_penalty,
                    score=grade_penalty+queue_penalty+hard_penalty))
            face=min(candidates,key=lambda c:c['score'])['face']
        t.update(face=face,material='waste' if waste else 'ore',state='queue_at_shovel',timer=0,position=0,speed=0,wait_since=self.minute*60)
        t['decision']=dict(minute=self.minute,truck=t['id'],policy=self.settings['dispatch'],chosen=face,candidates=candidates)
        self.last_dispatch=copy.deepcopy(t['decision'])
        t['reason']='Required waste movement' if waste else f"{self.settings['dispatch']} dispatch; target {self.settings['target_grade']:.2f}% Cu"
        self.event(f"{t['label']} to {face}: {t['reason']}.")

    def route_capacity(self,route):
        return min(self.settings['road_capacity'],12) if route=='road-main' and self.active_scenario=='road-congestion' else self.settings['road_capacity']

    def travel_seconds(self,route,loaded,material='ore'):
        # Synthetic average-speed law, not a manufacturer's truck performance curve.
        distance=2.5 if material=='waste' else (5.2 if route=='road-north' else 3.8)
        grade=self.settings['north_grade'] if route=='road-north' else self.settings['main_grade']
        flat_speed=3.8/(self.settings['haul_minutes']/60)*1.30
        speed=flat_speed/(1+.05*grade) if loaded else flat_speed/(.85*(1+.05*grade))
        speed=min(45 if loaded else 50,speed)
        return distance/speed*3600

    def queue_road(self,t,loaded):
        t.update(state='queue_road_loaded' if loaded else 'queue_road_empty',
                 route='road-north' if self.road_main_closed else 'road-main',
                 wait_since=self.minute*60,speed=0,position=0 if loaded else 1)

    def admit_road(self,t):
        loaded=t['state']=='queue_road_loaded';direction='loaded' if loaded else 'empty'
        route='road-north' if self.road_main_closed else 'road-main';t['route']=route
        now=self.minute*60
        queue=[x for x in self.trucks if x['state']==t['state']]
        first=min(queue,key=lambda x:(x['wait_since'],x['id']))
        if first is not t or now+1e-8<self.road_next[route][direction]:return
        self.road_next[route][direction]=now+3600/self.route_capacity(route)
        self.road_entries[route][direction]+=1
        self._stage(t,'loaded_haul' if loaded else 'empty_return',self.travel_seconds(route,loaded,t['material']))

    def waiting(self,t,dt):
        self.wait_seconds+=dt;t['wait_seconds']+=dt

    def _stage(self,t,state,duration):t.update(state=state,timer=0.0,duration=max(duration,1.0))

    def step(self,seconds):
        if not math.isfinite(seconds) or not 0<seconds<=86400:raise ValueError('Step must be in (0, 86400] seconds')
        # Bounded substeps keep throughput integration stable at every UI speed.
        left=seconds
        while left>1e-8:
            dt=min(5.0,left);left-=dt;self.minute+=dt/60
            for t in self.trucks:self._truck_step(t,dt)
            self._crush(dt)

    def _truck_step(self,t,dt):
        state=t['state']
        if state in ('parked','maintenance'):return
        if state=='waiting_for_resource':
            self.waiting(t,dt)
            if self.available_faces():self.assign(t)
            return
        if state in ('queue_road_loaded','queue_road_empty'):
            self.waiting(t,dt);self.admit_road(t);return
        if state=='queue_at_shovel':
            self.waiting(t,dt)
            if self.remaining[t['face']]<=1e-8 or not self.shovel_online[self.shovel(t['face'])]:
                self.assign(t);return

            queue=[x for x in self.trucks if x['state']=='queue_at_shovel' and self.shovel(x['face'])==self.shovel(t['face'])]

# Data and assumptions

## Public site facts

The twin uses Aktogay as a real-world reference for the site identity and
process route. KAZ Minerals describes Aktogay as an open-pit operation in
Kazakhstan with two sulphide concentrators and a combined design capacity of
50 Mt/year. Its public materials describe the original concentrator at 25
Mt/year and the second 25 Mt/year expansion.

Sources:

1. KAZ Minerals, [Annual Report and Accounts 2017](https://www.kazminerals.com/media/6188/kaz-minerals-2017-ara-web-ready-version.pdf),
   p. 30, Aktogay section. Reports 25 million tonnes per year capacity for the
   existing concentrator when fully ramped up and the expansion plan to double
   sulphide processing capacity to 50 million tonnes per year.
2. KAZ Minerals, [Aktogay](https://www.kazminerals.com/our-locations/aktogay/),
   official operations page, accessed 15 October 2026. Reports two sulphide
   concentrators with combined capacity of 50 Mtpa.
3. KAZ Minerals, [Aktogay expansion project approved](https://www.kazminerals.com/aktogay-expansion-project-approved/),
   2017. States that the first sulphide concentrator had 25 Mt/year capacity
   and the expansion would double it to 50 Mt/year.
4. KAZ Minerals, [Presidential opening of the Aktogay expansion project](https://www.kazminerals.com/presidential-opening-of-the-aktogay-expansion-project/),
   2021. Describes the new 25 Mtpa concentrator and the resulting 50 Mtpa
   combined sulphide capacity.

The model chooses one representative 25 Mt/year line. It does not represent
the site's two-line combined capacity as one line. The annualized simulator
basis is:

`3,200 t/h × 24 h/day × 365 day/year × 0.90 availability = 25.23 Mt/year`

The 3,200 t/h and 90% factor are synthetic model settings selected to express
one 25 Mt/year line. They are not statements of actual Aktogay operating
throughput or availability.

## Synthetic values and adjustable ranges

| Parameter | Default | UI range / rule |
|---|---:|---|
| Active 220 t trucks | 8 | 2–8; remaining twins are parked |
| Shovel loading | 6.5 min | 3–12 min, seeded ±8% variability; two shared resources |
| Main loaded haul | 9 min | 5–20 min; reference speed at 6% main-road grade |
| Empty return | 0.85 × loaded-leg duration | Longer alternative route remains effective |
| Main/north road distance | 3.8 / 5.2 km | Used in travel time; scene units are schematic |
| Ore-face grades F1/F2/F3 | 0.31 / 0.39 / 0.27 % Cu | Each 0.10–1.00 % Cu |
| Grade target | 0.34 % Cu | 0.15–0.80 % Cu; target may be infeasible for selected face grades |
| Base hardness | 12.4 kWh/t | 8–24; face offsets +0.6 / −0.9 / +2.6 |
| ROM capacity / initial inventory | 24,000 / 8,000 t | Initial grade 0.34%; hardness equals configured base |
| Crusher capacity | 3,200 t/h | 500–4,500 t/h |
| Specific combined plant energy | 21 kWh/t | Fixed illustrative intensity; 8 crusher + 13 concentrator |
| Available power | 75 MW | 10–90 MW; fault caps supply at min(configured,45) |
| Simulation speed | 60× | 1–180× |
| Seed | 64 | Integer 0–999999 |

One waste assignment occurs per eleven dispatches. SH-02 serves F2; SH-01 is a
shared loading resource for F1/F3/waste. Shovel relocation time is omitted.
The ROM dumping bay handles one truck at a time, with a 72-second service.
Grades and hardness are sampled at the start of loading and remain attached to
that material. New settings require pause and reset; speed alone changes live.
